faq.q: What does a product demo video show?
faq.a: It shows one useful operation from start to finish, such as a lid opening, a latch closing, a pour or a switch turning on.

faq.q: How is this different from image to video?
faq.a: Image to video adds motion to a still. A product demo focuses on one operation or buyer question so the feature is easy to inspect.

faq.q: What product photo should I upload?
faq.a: Use one sharp photo with the full item and the moving part visible. Even light and clear edges give the action more room to read.

faq.q: Which actions work well for product videos?
faq.a: Opening, closing, pouring, packing, connecting, switching on and fitting work well when the product can perform the action in real life.

faq.q: Which video sizes and lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4, plus 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the frame and length that suit the channel and the action.

faq.q: Will the demo show my product accurately?
faq.a: Review every result beside the real item before posting. If a button, color or moving part drifts, make another version instead of publishing it.

faq.q: Can I add the price and product name?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact names, prices and dates later in Canva, CapCut or your ad editor so the generated scene stays clean.

faq.q: Can I use a product demo for a listing or paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Download the demo, place it beside your listing photos or in your ad, and check the marketplace or platform rules before launch.
